artworks.title: A Buffalo Wallow
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a herd of bison on a slope. The horizon line is high, dividing the grassy field and sky. The bison are spread out, with those closer detailed, and those further away less defined. The brushstrokes are smooth, depicting fur and grass texture realistically. The color palette is serene, with earthy browns of the bison contrasting greens of the grass under a soft blue and grey sky.

artworks.title: Buffalo Chase - Bulls Protecting the Calves
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling green hills stretching into the distance. The horizon is high in the composition, with a sky filled with wispy clouds. In the center, two figures on horseback are engaging with a herd of buffalo. The color palette consists of earthy greens, browns, and vibrant blues. More hills are visible in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Bulls Fighting
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large herd of bison. The perspective is elevated, showcasing numerous bison spread across a plain. Two bison are seen in the foreground engaging in a struggle. In the background, the herd is dispersed across the grassy expanse leading toward the horizon. The horizon is high in the image with distant bison and some trees. The sky above shows soft tan, brown, and hints of blue, possibly indicating dawn or dusk. The brushstrokes are smooth, conveying movement among the bison. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, with deep browns of the bison contrasting the lighter greens and yellows of the grass.

artworks.title: K'nisteneux Indians Attacking Two Grizzly Bears
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting horsemen engaging in a confrontation with bears. The scene shows a grassy landscape with scattered trees and an open sky. Several individuals on horseback are involved in an encounter with the bears. The horses are in motion, some rearing up, suggesting the intensity of the situation. The composition is dynamic, focusing on the interaction between the riders, horses, and bears. Details include traditional attire of the people and their adornments, as well as the postures of the animals. This is in the style of George Catlin, known for his paintings of Native American life and wildlife.

artworks.title: Pipe Dance - Assinneboine
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering of indigenous people among teepees. In the painting, a group of individuals encircle a central activity near several conical tents. The scene is set in a grassy open area with green foliage and trees in the background. The individuals are adorned in traditional attire with headdresses, and they appear to be engaged in a communal or ceremonial gathering. The atmosphere is calm and depicts a sense of community and tradition. This is in the style of George Catlin, known for his paintings of Native American life.

artworks.title: Horse Racing - Minatarrees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a gathering of Native Americans. A large group of people are gathered, some on horseback, with others standing in a circle. There are more riders spread across the landscape in the distance. The horizon is flat and uninterrupted, balancing the composition. The sky above shows soft, horizontal strokes with gentle cloud formations. The color palette is warm and earthy, dominated by shades of green in the grass and light blue in the sky, along with natural tones in the people's clothing.

artworks.title: Catlin Painting the Portrait of Mah-to-toh-pa - Mandan
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a large group of people outdoors. In the center, two people face each other, one painting a portrait of the other.  Every person in the image except the painter has reddish-brown skin; the painter has pale, yellowish skin. To the left of center, the person being painted stands tall, wearing intricately decorated clothing. They wear a long, tan garment painted with several designs, such as feathers, a handprint, and a colorful circle. The front of the garment has a wide red stripe running down it. On their legs, they wear tan pants with long black tassels on the side. Down the sides of the long garment and the pants are bright squares of teal, yellow, and red. On top of their long black hair, this person wears a long headdress made of white and black feathers that travel from their head all the way to the ground. They also wear thin red horns on their head, and they hold a tall staff or spear decorated with feathers and red fringe. On the right, the person with pale skin paints a depiction of the staff-wielder on a tan canvas. This person holds a palette and several brushes. They wear a simple brown tunic, brown pants, a white collar, and a brown hat. Surrounding these two people is a large crowd of other people kneeling, sitting, standing, or riding on horseback. These onlookers have a range of expressions, and they wear a variety of clothes. Most of them wear tan garments, and some have necklaces around their necks or red paint on their arms. Many of them have feathers in their black hair. Close to us, some small dogs sit among the seated onlookers. The group is positioned on green, grassy ground, with tall trees in the distance. The sky overhead is blue-gray, and there appears to be a blue river off to the right. The entire composition is framed within a dark oval border, outside of which is plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Prairie Dog Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of vast plains with small mounds of earth, a high horizon, greenish-yellow grassy land, light blue mountains, a sky with pale blue and soft gray clouds, meticulous brushwork with fine details illustrating texture, an earthy color palette with greens, yellows, and browns, and figures including a hunter and two riders on horseback.

artworks.title: Fort Union
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows an expansive landscape from an elevated perspective. A wide grassy plain with teepees and small figures is observed. Green rolling hills lead to the plain, with scattered teepees indicating human habitation. A line of trees stretches into the distance, guiding towards the horizon. Distant mountain ridges are visible on the horizon. The painting features smooth brushwork capturing the scene's expanse. The color palette includes shades of green, earthy browns, and reds for the teepees, under a sky with light gray, white clouds, and hints of blue. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and vast.

artworks.title: Making Flint Arrowheads - Apachees
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a straightforward, eye-level perspective of a scene with a shelter and teepees. The horizon is high, with lush trees as the backdrop. The brushstrokes are smooth and controlled, portraying the elements realistically. The color palette is earthy, with browns, greens, and hints of blue sky. People are seated under the shelter while items hang to dry. Two teepees stand in the distance with figures and a dog nearby. Greenery and soft blues dominate the background, creating a serene setting.

artworks.title: Facsimile of Chief Four Men's Robe - Mandan
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a decorative hide. The painting depicts a tan hide with intricate illustrations spread over its surface. The hide has irregular, wavy edges characteristic of natural skin. Adorning the hide are detailed and vibrant scenes featuring stylized figures and horses, depicted in rows across the expanse of the hide. These illustrations are reminiscent of traditional indigenous or native artworks, presenting scenes of hunting or combat, where adorned figures, possibly representing warriors, are interacting with horses in dynamic poses. Below the illustrated area, at the bottom, there appears to be a fringe-like detail, possibly representing tassels made of material reminiscent of leather or sinew. The hide is set against a muted greyish-brown background with a border framed by a wooden or painted green edge.

artworks.title: An Indian Encampment at Sunset
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image is an oval-shaped painting capturing a wide landscape scene. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with rolling hills against a sky in warm hues. The sky has fluid brushstrokes transitioning from golds and oranges near the horizon to darker browns and greys. In the foreground, there are tepees and small figures suggesting a settlement. Animals are grazing in the middle ground, with trees in the background. The color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and warm tones from the sky.

artworks.title: Curious Grassy Bluffs, St. Peter's River
artworks.medium: oil on canvas
artworks.description: A landscape with a flowing river curving through the scene. Hills meet the sky with clouds in the distance. Smooth brushstrokes create a serene atmosphere. Earthy greens, browns, and blues form a calm palette. Trees, plants, and hills fill the composition, guiding the eye towards the horizon.

artworks.title: View in the "Grand Detour," Upper Missouri
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a river flowing diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. A canoe with three figures is visible in the water. Rolling hills are seen in the distance, with sunlight illuminating their surfaces. The color palette includes earthy tones, lush greens along the riverbanks, and a pale blue sky with clouds.

artworks.title: Falls of the Snake River
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts an elevated point of view of a broad landscape. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant mountains against a light blue sky with scattered clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth and blended, creating depth and atmosphere. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns in the landscape, and cooler blues and grays in the mountains and sky. Close to us, a group of horses stands near trees, with figures by a river and a waterfall in the background. The middle ground contains more trees and greenery leading to the distant horizon.

artworks.title: Grassy Bluffs, Upper Missouri
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with elevated terrain and a river winding through it. Small figures can be seen on the hills. The scenery includes lush greenery, smooth brushstrokes, and a color palette of greens, grays, blues, browns, tans, pinks, and muted oranges.

artworks.title: Prairie Meadows Burning
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: View of "Pike's Tent"
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing from near to far in the center, surrounded by hills and a large conical hill in the distance. The painting has smooth brushstrokes and a color palette of green hues for the vegetation, muted earth tones for the hill, and soft tones for the sky. There is a small canoe with figures near the river.

artworks.title: Scene from the Lower Mississippi
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image presents a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, looking over a wide river winding into the distance. The horizon is positioned quite low, and the sky dominates the upper half of the scene, displaying a blend of blue with hints of pink and gray clouds. Distant trees frame the river on the horizon. Close to us, the left side features dense clusters of tall trees with green foliage, while the opposite riverbank to the right has a line of trees along the water's edge. The color palette is earthy, with shades of green for the vegetation and muted tones of brown and gray for the riverbanks and driftwood. The brushstrokes vary in intensity, softer in the sky and river, and more defined on the trees, contributing to an impressionistic effect.

artworks.title: Catlin and Two Companions Shooting Buffalo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with three men in the foreground. One of the men is aiming a rifle, while the others are in the grass. In the background, a herd of bison is grazing in a sunlit meadow. The horizon is marked by hills with trees, and the sky has light brushstrokes suggesting a clear day. The color palette is dominated by greens and browns, with trees on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Nayas Village - Indians Bathing
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a native settlement by the seaside from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is located towards the upper third of the composition, where the sea meets the sky. A warm, golden hue is present at the horizon. The brushstrokes are smooth in the depiction of the sky and water. The scene includes tents and structures with people engaging in various activities. The color palette consists of earthy browns, greens, soft blues, and golden tones. In the distance, the sea is visible with more figures.

artworks.title: The Scalper Scalped - Pawnees and Cheyennes
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of three riders on horseback in a prairie setting. The central figure raises his hands, the rider on a pale horse seems unbalanced, and the third rider carries a bow. The background shows a sky blending blue and peach, with grass and rocks on the ground. The scene is framed within an oval shape with a green border. This style resembles that of George Catlin.

artworks.title: An Apachee Village
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with numerous conical tents arranged in a village. In the background, there is a line of trees marking the horizon, with low hills and a body of water further away. The sky shows a gradient from golden yellows to soft blues. Figures and tents are scattered across the landscape, indicating human activity. The color palette consists mainly of warm earthy tones, with the sky casting a soft light over the scene.

artworks.title: Salmon River Mountains
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rolling hills and mountain peaks extending into the distance. The brushstrokes are smooth and somewhat blended. The color palette includes muted earth tones such as greens, browns, and whites for the mountains with hints of snow. The sky varies from light blue to dark gray. Clusters of trees are visible close to the viewer.
